gen-gf-bellota-gf-kodchasan: Distinctive up top, with s-curves whose ends drift wide of the stem. Bellota traces every stroke at one stylus width, while Kodchasan, with open terminals and no thinning, would carry paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kosugi: Commanding from its hanging s-ends down, Bellota traces each stroke with one stylus, while Kosugi bends wire-like letters with a pliers-jawed c. Give Kosugi a little extra size to let that open jaw breathe.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kosugi-maru: Bellota lets its s ends hang wide and traces strokes with one stylus, while Kosugi Maru glows at a single line thickness. Bellota commands attention; the sans below is the clean, contemporary one.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kumbh-sans: Hand-traced swagger on top, with s-ends that drift wide. Kumbh Sans cuts its terminals short of the bowl, so paragraphs below Bellota would read in a steady, unhurried hum.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-lato: Bellota draws every stroke like neon tube, s-ends hanging wide, distinctive and commanding. And Lato, the plain sans, barely curls its wide s curves and welcomes a slightly larger body size.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-libre-franklin: Bellota lays down a plain stripe of constant ink with s-ends that hang wide, while Libre Franklin adds a splayed c terminal. Display swagger up top, professional sans below.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-livvic: Livvic is approachable, its curves free of stress and c generously open. Beneath Bellota, whose stylus-width strokes and hanging s-ends command attention, those sans-serif curves would carry paragraphs with ease.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-lunasima: Stylus-drawn drama, with s-ends that hang wide. Bellota takes the headline with uniform strokes framing its counters, while Lunasima, sans-serif with c tips that never creep toward touching, settles in underneath.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-1p: Untapered swagger from Bellota, every stroke traced by one stylus. M PLUS 1p, plain sans through and through, leaves every curve end open, and that clean openness is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Every Bellota stroke is traced at one stylus width, while M PLUS Code Latin bends neon tubing into wide-mouthed letters. Distinctive above, approachable below, and clean in both places.
